We have approved the temporary POD storage in the parking lot.

body.content:
Dear Bharath,  
  
As previously agreed, you selected the exterior stair renovation instead of
two months of free rent. We cannot provide both. The space was rented in "as-
is" condition, and the landlord is not responsible for tenant improvements
other than the fire alarm installation. However, the landlord has already
covered significant expenses, including city permits, architect fees, and
general contractor costs for the stair renovation, as well as extending your
rent-free period by six months.  
  
Please be advised that your request for modifications to the lease agreement
has been denied, and the current lease terms remain in effect.  
  
As a reminder, your rent is due on December 1st. If payment is not received by
December 5th, a late fee will be applied, and we will initiate legal eviction
proceedings to recover all associated costs.  
  
Sincerely,  
  
Alex Jo  
NW Prime Properties, Inc.

  

  

  

On Fri, Oct 16, 2026 at 5:55 AM Bharath Mysore
<[bharathkumarmn@hotmail.com](mailto:bharathkumarmn@hotmail.com)> wrote:  

> Hi Alex,
>
>  
>
>
> Thank you again for your continued support and for offering your team's help
> with the exterior exit work. I am actively working with the City, our
> Franchise, and the GC to expedite everything on our end.
>
>  
>
>
> When we spoke on September 4th, you had mentioned being open to a couple of
> months of rent rebate to help bridge the unexpected timeline impact. In that
> spirit, the attached amendment formally extends the Base Rent abatement
> through February 28, 2027, establishing March 1, 2027 as the Base Rent
> activation date.
>
>  
>
>
> Importantly, Smash District LLC remains fully current on, and will continue
> paying, all Additional Rent (NNN operating costs and utilities) every month
> without interruption.
>
>  
>
>
> Please review the attached draft. If this works, let me know and we will get
> it signed so both of our accounting teams have complete clarity heading into
> year-end.
>
>  
>
>
> Regards
>
> Bharath

message.display_title: Re: Next Steps — Revised Egress Plans and City CO for iSmash Everett [WAS Re: CO]

key_updates.summary: October 16 2:11 PM PDT: Alex denies the lease amendment, asserts that exterior stair renovation was chosen instead of two months of free rent, and says rent is due December 1 with a late fee and threatened eviction proceedings if not received by December 5. These are landlord assertions; this refresh does not verify lease interpretation, any prior election, or enforceability.

key_updates.topic: POD approved; landlord to arrange separate stair inspection
key_updates.summary: Owner requested a 16-foot POD for one month for materials arriving November 6/7 and stair completion/inspection dates. At 2:25 PM Alex approved the temporary POD and said his team would arrange the exterior-stair inspection under a separate permit after its work was complete; he would expedite production. No firm completion or inspection date.

key_updates.topic: iSmash escalates delay after requested payments
key_updates.summary: At 11:58 AM iSmash says Carney missed the weekly call, reports no contractors onsite, says every requested payment was made despite the earlier halt-until-paid position, asks for fountain receipt and work dates, and sets October 23 as latest inspection target. Party report, not bank reconciliation, independent site inspection or City-issued deadline.

key_updates.topic: Troy reports fountain problem; electrician date missing
key_updates.summary: At noon Troy reports plumber attended but encountered an unspecified high-low fountain issue, promises a date when known, and says an electrician is scheduled for exit-sign relocation without giving a date. Floor/desk/rear-door work is reported complete. At 2:28 PM Scott asks what plumbing problem occurred and when electrician is scheduled; he says desk still needs securing to floor. Troy also asks landlord-work status; Scott reports stair fabrication on target. No later answer or confirmed completion date found.

Archived October 16 11:30 AM meeting-report email, received 11:48 AM. AI-generated summary references unfinished shelving, emergency lights and fountain, planned November 7 opening dependent on CO, and Goodwill delivery/storage coordination. Email summary only, not a downloaded full transcript/audio/video.
Preserved a general iSmash expansion newsletter separately from Everett project evidence; no Everett completion or CO finding inferred.

limitations: Bounded connector refresh, not a complete mailbox, original MIME export, or forensic acquisition. Ten targeted searches and both recent-message list pages exhausted returned pagination.

Eleven unique messages retained: nine after prior cutoff (eight case-related, including Read.ai report email, and one general franchise newsletter), plus two previously archived overlap messages. Local E001-E011 labels apply only to this snapshot.
Full connector-returned bodies and quoted chains retained. Body content may be Markdown despite the connector HTML label. Original IDs, URLs, receivedDateTime and sender/recipient metadata retained.
All narrative dates use America/Los_Angeles. Some quoted email headers show other local time zones and are not substituted for normalized received timestamps.
All selected messages have has_attachments=false. Inline images/remote images in bodies were not downloaded; no attachment payloads were fetched or inspected.
iSmash's payment-completion and absence-of-workers claims are party statements. Troy gives a different same-day account that a plumber attended; no independent site or bank verification was made.
Alex's rejection supersedes morning no-response status but does not prove a prior binding election of stairs over free rent, lease allocation, or lawful eviction procedure. No legal conclusion made.

October 23 inspection target comes from iSmash, not an independently verified City deadline or booked inspection. November 7 opening appears as a plan in an AI-generated report and remains conditional on CO.

No new direct City, Onesta, Quaint Oak, GPN or Thomas Sign project update was located; no tenant-plan approval, passed final inspection, CO, fountain completion, loading-dock gate completion or signage payment receipt was found in the bounded refresh.
Read.ai material is the emailed machine-generated report summary, not a full transcript/audio/video acquisition; existing transcript archive remains untouched.
Unrelated mailbox records were excluded from archive. Earlier evidence preserved; no email sent, payment initiated, agreement accepted, mailbox modified or permit action performed.
Private correspondence and tokenized source links retained locally; redact before external sharing.
